#summary Downloads and Update Site of the EMFStore

This site contains releases and nightly builds of the EMFStore. Also we provide new and noteworthy information on the releases and nightly builds here. Currently there are only nightly builds. 
All builds are distributed under the [http://www.eclipse.org/legal/epl-v10.html Eclipse Public License (EPL)].

==Nightly builds==

The EMFStore features can be installed from this update site:

[http://unicase.googlecode.com/svn/updatesite/emfstoreNightly http://unicase.googlecode.com/svn/updatesite/emfstoreNightly]

<wiki:comment>
